messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — AcmeCorp reports persistent 503s on our hosted embeddings endpoint (us-west1) over the last 30m. p95 latency jumped then requests started failing. They say SDK retries are looping and causing duplicate billing. Sample: SDK v1.4.2, 60 concurrent embed calls. Can someone triage? https://acmecorp.example/ticket/1234

Support Bot: Ticket #5678 created and linked to this thread.

Mira S: Thanks Alex. Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the user-agent they send? Also is this only us-west1 or multi-region?

Alex R: Repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" 
 -H "User-Agent: acme-sdk/1.4.2" 
 -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["a","b"]}'
```
Happens only in us-west1; they mentioned keys were rotated ~2h before spike.

Shawn L: I'm on it — seeing elevated 503s from edge-ingress in us-west1 starting ~1745559200. Correlates with a large auth-token rotation fanout from control plane. Investigating auth-service errors -> gateway 503.

SRE-bot: Alert: auth-rotation-fanout rate=1.1k/s, error-rate(auth-service)=8.4% -> upstream gateway 503s.

Mira S: Likely the rotation caused a short-lived auth cache miss storm at the edge which propagated into request failures + immediate SDK retries. Short-term mitigations: 1) temporarily increase keepalive and connection pooling on ingress proxies, 2) apply a cached-header fallback for affected tenants, 3) advise client to apply exponential backoff with jitter.

Alex R: Customer wants a fast mitigation and ETA. They also flagged duplicate billing from retry loops. Any quick actions we can take server-side?

Shawn L: I can push a tenant-specific route to use cached auth headers (disable fresh token fetch per-request) for AcmeOrg. Pushed to canary (us-west1-canary). If stable, roll to region. Also reduced ingress re-auth frequency to 30s for canary. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/auth-fanout.md

DevX Eng: We should also ship a patch to the SDK: default to 200ms base exponential backoff and max retries=3 for non-idempotent embed requests, and expose retry config. I'll open an issue and small PR.

Support Bot: Noted — customer notified with temporary client workaround (enable backoff) and that we're running a canary route to reduce errors.

Customer Ops: Please confirm when canary is stable so we can update the customer and request refund for duplicate charges if needed.

Shawn L: Canary metrics at +10m: error-rate down 16% -> 1.2% for AcmeOrg in canary slice; p95 latency normalized. Rolling config to all us-west1 nodes now. Monitoring for 30m.

Alex R: Customer confirms errors dropped and retry storms stopped. They saw reduced duplicate billing. They asked for post-mortem and ETA for SDK patch.

Mira S: Filing incident ticket and post-mortem. Action items: (1) update SDK defaults (DevX), (2) add staging test for auth-rotation fanout (Infra), (3) document tenant-level fallback in runbook (SRE).

DevX Eng: Created SDK issue #982 and small PR with backoff defaults. Will request review today.

Shawn L: Rolling completed. Observability shows steady state. Closing active escalation for AcmeOrg, will include timeline in post-mortem. :thumbsup:

Alex R: Thanks all — I'll follow up with customer and close support ticket after PM published.

Support Bot: Ticket #5678 marked "waiting on post-mortem".
